page.overview:
Who is Gramps?

Gramps is a character in Final Fantasy Dimensions.

Gramps has grey hair is wrapped into braids and he dons a raggedy cloak, paired with leggings, sandals and a red scarf while armed with his bow and arrows. He also wears a hat, decorated with a red feather from an unspecified creature.

As Freyr, he has long, light blue hair and looks much younger in appearance due to Elves not aging. Along with his crown, he wears a regal attire befitting that of a monarch, completed by his red cape.

Gramps is an old man afflicted with blindness and amnesia. He has a natural disposition towards aiding the forests and its creatures. He is also extremely lewd and perverted in his actions towards women, particularly of the younger variation. He is an excellent sharpshooter and huntsman, being able to detect and shoot an arrow at a spy from an incredibly specified distance. He often has headaches which seem to play a role in his amnesia.
